📉 Why 42 Macro Is Waiting to Buy the Bitcoin Dip

42 Macro founder Darius Dale says his firm has already cut its Bitcoin exposure and is waiting for the sell-off to run its course before buying again. He warns that sticky inflation could push the Fed to tighten further, draining the liquidity Bitcoin depends on — and sees BTC possibly falling to around $38,400 if stocks keep sliding. Still, he expects conditions to turn far more favorable by mid-2027, when easing inflation could let the Fed pivot.
